Hi, because the Home Connect API that it is used on this integration, does not support everything that the Home Connect app supports, your suggestions cannot be accomplished because that options are not supported.
Except for the oven temperature. On 2025.3, you will be able to configure the oven temperature. And the current temperature can be obtained, but the documentation recommends not to use it:
> We recommend not to use the event _Cooking.Oven.Status.CurrentCavityTemperature_ because the temperature might not provide the necessary accuracy.

@MartinHjelmare, should we support it and add a disclaimer on the integration documentation?
